What needs to happen is a lower level cap transfer service. So when a player reaches a certain level, they should be able to link their account from the other game and then they can select locations to transfer into the new game. What that does is keeps the lower levels of the original game alive without disrupting serious players, and it's also enough of a taster that players of the other game may stick with it and play the original game too. Helps both communities.
to add to that: if you can connect with a high-level player in the game, you can reach level 8 in one intense day with them providing you gear, it's really not difficult.
